snippet.title: Not Quite Trash - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🗑️ **Not Quite Trash — Turn Junk Into Treasure!**

Welcome to Not Quite Trash, a cozy shop simulator filled with weird discoveries, quirky customers, and a healthy dose of absurd humor!

Dig through a massive pile of junk, discover unusual items with mysterious properties, sort your treasures, and sell them to customers who might be even stranger than the things you're selling.

💰 Build and expand your very own second-hand shop!

🤖 Unlock helpful drones to automate your business!

✨ Discover strange and unexpected items!

🛒 Meet hilarious customers with unique personalities!

♻️ Because even trash deserves a second chance!

🎮 **WISHLIST ON STEAM:**
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4814650/Not_Quite_Trash/

❤️ Every wishlist, like, comment, and subscription helps support indie development!

Made with love, caffeine, and questionable life decisions. ☕🗑️
